output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-64622020ffb2] is just a metric name. The section it sits in [ev-1f419676f177] supplies the rest. It says the listed metrics that start with `cortex_` will start with `loki_` in this release. It also says operators can keep the old prefix by changing `metrics_namespace` from the default `loki` to `cortex`. That gives the subject (the metric `cortex_ruler_sync_rules_total`), the change (a rename to the `loki_` prefix) and who is exposed (setups that leave `metrics_namespace` at its default). The consequence is that the metric is exported under the new name, which is why the guide offers the `metrics_namespace` setting to keep the old prefix.
